classification.difficultyReason: Relate the scoop radius to the cube side, subtract hemisphere volume from cube volume, and express the remainder as a percentage of the original.

content.prompt:
A hemispherical scoop of ice-cream is taken out of a cubic tub. The scoop's diameter equals the side length of the cube.
Find the volume that remains, as a percentage of the original volume, to the nearest whole percent.

spec.description: Outline cube with an inscribed circular opening in its top face, a Hollow arrow, equal-edge double ticks and a red dashed hemispherical cavity. Decorative surface and opening fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: Cube side 1 cm. The circular opening has diameter 1 cm. Double ticks identify equal cube edges; the dashed red curve identifies the removed hemisphere.
spec.answerVisibility: The cube side and hollow geometry are given; radius, volumes and percentage are absent.
